ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with localized high-intensity (white) nodes; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.04.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete circular white nodes (5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes; highest concentration of white blobs observed in the distal regions and along the lateral edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth extends roughly 18% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude varies from 3 to 12 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with concave geometry near the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast clusters (white-on-black) corresponding to barnacle attachment sites; prominent grouping of approximately 12 rosettes on the left lobe and 10 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear grey streaks visible on the mid-to-upper surface of the right lobe, oriented at approximately 30 degrees from the horizontal.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged morphology and significant tissue loss/encrustation on the far-left lateral tip, creating a non-uniform terminal boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy cluster of live barnacles and associated calcification protruding from the extreme upper-left lateral margin.
